description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取A股公司A股通（北向）持仓汇总数据。可按股票代码批量查询，返回最新数据日期、A股通持股量/持仓金额/持股占流通A股比例，以及近1/2/3/4个季度的净买入金额/净买入股数/持股占流通股比变化等多档数据。当用户想查询当前A股通持仓金额/占比最大的前N家公司、或者查询查询某段时间下A股通持仓数据变化最大的前N家公司、或者查询某上市公司或者对比某些上市公司在不同周期下的A股通持仓规模与变化比例的统计数据、追踪外资阶段性买卖节奏时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain Stock Connect shareholding and trading data for A-share stocks (Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect + Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect). Supports batch query by stock code, returning fields such as latest data date, Shanghai Connect share quantity/market value/share ratio, Shenzhen Connect share quantity/market value/share ratio, and Shanghai Connect net purchase amount/quantity/share changes for the last 1/2/3/4 quarters. Call this interface when users want to understand Stock Connect holding changes for an A-share or track foreign capital trading activity.
